basis: Congenital cervicofacial cutaneous fibrocartilaginous remnants; cartilage within a skin lesion does not establish locomotor disease.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: cervicofacial fibrochondromatous remnants are cutaneous/subcutaneous lesions.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: ectopic cartilage within cutaneous remnants does not establish disease of the locomotor system.

basis: Cognitive impairment 80-99%; cardiac defects, glaucoma and hearing impairment each 30-79%. Urinary anomalies omitted at cap; lung lobation alone lacks established dysfunction.

decisions.renal: none: urinary tract anomalies occur in 30-79%, but functional severity is unspecified; omitted under the cap in favor of established cardiac, visual and hearing involvement.
decisions.otologic: involved: hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%, establishing common loss of auditory function.

basis: Presynaptic neuromuscular junction disorder; fixed arthrogryposis occurs in 2/5 (40%). Ophthalmoparesis, dysphagia and hypoventilation reflect neuromuscular dysfunction.

decisions.ocular: none: ptosis and ophthalmoparesis in 5/5 reflect neuromuscular junction dysfunction, without evidence of intrinsic ocular damage.

basis: Copper transport disorder; seizures and acne occur in 30-79%, with characteristic seborrheic dermatitis. Anemia and skeletal changes occur in 5-29%.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: abnormal immune physiology in 80-99% is nonspecific and does not establish immunodeficiency, infection or immune-mediated disease.

basis: CLN3 lysosomal storage disease defined by early retinal degeneration and visual loss, followed by unusually slow neurologic deterioration.

decisions.ocular: primary: early retinal degeneration and progressive visual loss are defining features of protracted juvenile CLN3 disease.

basis: Congenital ocular motor nerve dysinnervation defines restricted eye movement and globe retraction. Hearing impairment occurs in 3/14 (~21%), below threshold.

decisions.neurologic: primary: congenital cranial nerve dysinnervation is the defining anatomical lesion underlying Duane retraction syndrome.

basis: Complete LCAT deficiency with defining hemolytic anemia and corneal dystrophy; renal lipid deposition causes proteinuria in most. Renal retained as fourth axis under primary cap.

decisions.haematologic: primary: hemolytic anemia is a defining component of complete LCAT deficiency.
decisions.renal: involved: renal lipid deposition causes proteinuric nephropathy in most, with progressive renal failure; assigned here because primary is capped at three.

basis: Pontocerebellar hypoplasia defines disease; structural skeletal muscle atrophy occurs in 3/3 and optic atrophy in 2/4. Genital anomalies alone do not establish endocrine dysfunction.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: skeletal muscle atrophy in 3/3 assessed patients documents structural muscle loss, beyond weakness or hypotonia alone.

basis: Bacterial infection usually involves oral and upper airway mucosa with pseudomembranous injury. Myocarditis and neuropathy are minority, separately diagnosed complications.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: the definition explicitly identifies the oral cavity as a usual site of pseudomembranous infection; oral mucosa belongs to this axis.

basis: Inherited O-glycosylation disorder with muscular dystrophy and brain malformations; defining structural eye abnormalities occur in 1/1. Ocular tier reflects the three-primary cap.

decisions.ocular: involved: defining microphthalmia, coloboma and corneal opacity occur in 1/1; retained as the fourth axis because primary is capped at three.
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: this is an inherited disorder of alpha-dystroglycan O-glycosylation, supported by its metabolic ancestry.
